# T05 — Frozen-turbulence drag adjoint
Research: TinyFish search/fetch and installed OpenFOAM v2606 tutorial/source inspection, 2026-11-01.

- User manual, v2312: https://www.openfoam.com/documentation/files/adjointOptimisationFoamManual_v2312.pdf. Read the primal/adjoint managers, force objective, surface/point sensitivity, numerical settings, frozen-turbulence and boundary-condition sections. `active false` freezes the saved primal; the force objective uses a half-model Aref. `adjointRASModel adjointLaminar` implements the frozen-turbulence approximation. Surface normals point from fluid into solid: negate the saved normal sensitivity for the car-outward convention.
- Numerics improvements: https://www.openfoam.com/news/main-news/openfoam-v2312/numerics. Point/face interpolation consistency and symmetry-plane artifacts matter; do not infer physical design improvements from a colourful unvalidated map.
- Frozen vs differentiated turbulence: https://www.openfoam.com/news/main-news/openfoam-v2206/numerics. Frozen turbulence is an approximation and may differ materially from the full SST adjoint.
- Installed tutorial: `/Volumes/OpenFOAM-v2606/tutorials/incompressible/adjointOptimisationFoam/sensitivityMaps/motorBike`. Read optimisationDict, adjointRASProperties, Ua/pa, fvSchemes/fvSolution and README. Reused its single-run manager and point/face map configuration, not a second solver pipeline. The README cautions about steady adjoints for oscillating primal solutions.
- Installed laminar tutorial confirms the exact model keyword: `sensitivityMaps/naca0012/laminar/drag/constant/adjointRASProperties`.
- Installed `sensitivitySurfacePoints.C` confirms projection onto the finite-volume boundary normal and surface-area-normalisation semantics. Installed SIMPLEControlSingleRun caps the adjoint solve through `nIters`.

## Visual references
- https://www.openfoam.com/sites/default/files/prg/editor/1467/v2312-numerics-adjoint-drivaer_v2312-processed.png: smooth signed surface map with a diverging scale and preserved car silhouette.
- https://www.openfoam.com/sites/default/files/prg/editor/1467/v2312-numerics-adjoint-drivaer-btm_v2312-processed.png: inspect symmetry-plane continuity; no image is substituted for our absent solver result.

## Decisions
The task's generic `forceCoeffs` description becomes the documented `type force` objective. Both surfacePoints and surface maps are requested, as in the bundled motorBike tutorial; the discoverable scalar face map is interpolated to display vertices. The source normal is reversed for outward-car sensitivity, and the 99th-percentile scale is retained in metadata. All output remains conditional on primal mesh quality and actual adjoint convergence.
